reuse.why: Introduces a shared shouldWriteMonthBudget predicate and averageBudgetAmount used by every action, but detects #fixed with a lowercase substring check instead of the existing extractTagsFromText, and keeps a hand-written category query in each action.

duplication.why: The same categories + category_groups + notes query is written out in setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the 3/6/12-month averages (plus getBudgetData), so the data side of the rule is copied five times.

placement.why: The predicate and sign helper live in budget/actions.ts next to the actions, which fits the tree, though data selection is left at each action instead of with the predicate.

scope.why: Changes are about month-wide actions, but the diff also renames existing test locals in copyUntilYearEnd and reformats long signatures onto one line.

maintainability.why: Exclusion logic is centralised in one predicate, but any new exclusion needing a column must be added to five copied queries, and the substring tag check will match tags like #fixedish.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shouldWriteMonthBudget uses (group_notes).toLowerCase().includes('#fixed') instead of extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied category queries are overt near-identical copies in each action rather than disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldWriteMonthBudget gains only includeHiddenCategories; template and #fixed rules are base conditions; all month-wide actions call it, though each still selects its own rows.
